# ReMeet - Full Reference

> ReMeet is a done-for-you photo book design service. You send a link to your Google Photos or iCloud album, and a designer picks the best shots, removes duplicates and blurry frames, and lays out every page by hand. No templates, no drag-and-drop editor, no sorting on your end. First draft in 72 hours. Ask for changes in plain words. Full refund if you don't love the first draft. Designed PDF from $29, printing from $69 after you approve. Ships to the US, Canada and Europe.

## What makes ReMeet different

- You share a link to your album. A designer picks the best shots out of 50 or 5,000.
- Every page is designed by a person with 10 years in editorial design. No templates, no editor.
- AI sorts photos only. It never changes or generates your images.
- Your designed book from $29. Print it only when you love it.
- First draft in 72 hours. Two rounds of changes in plain words.
- Don't love the first draft? Full refund.
- Your handwritten notes, scanned and placed next to the right photos.
- Month by month. No duplicates, no blurry shots.
- Printed as a premium layflat or hardcover. Copies for the grandparents, shipped to the US, Canada and Europe.
- Season books for your nonprofit, team or school, every year.

## Pricing

- Designed PDF book, up to 30 pages: $29
- Designed PDF book, up to 100 pages: $79
- Upgrade from 30 to 100 pages after ordering: +$50
- Video frame extraction add-on: +$50
- Printed hardcover: from $69 after approval
- Printed premium layflat: from $129 after approval
- Extra printed copies: $69 each
- Shipping: included to the US and Canada, +$15 to Europe
- Your next book: 10% off the design
- Christmas 2026: order printing by Dec 1, a designed PDF by Dec 20
- Don't love the first draft? Full refund

## How it works

1. Pick your book type and page count on remeet.cc
2. Pay securely via Stripe
3. Share a link to your photos (iCloud link, Google Photos album, or any cloud folder)
4. A designer curates your best shots, removes duplicates, and designs every page
5. Receive a designed PDF proof within 72 hours
6. Request changes in plain language (two revision rounds included)
7. Approve and download your digital book
8. Optionally order a printed copy (from $69, US and Canada shipping included)

## FAQ

**How long does it take?**
First draft in 72 hours from when you share your photos. Each revision round takes about 24 hours.

**How many photos should I send?**
As many as you want, up to 5,000. The designer and AI pick the best ones. More photos means more to choose from.

**Do you use AI?**
AI helps sort photos, find duplicates, remove blurry shots, and pick the best frame of a burst. It never changes, generates, or edits your photos. Every page is designed and checked by a person.

**What if I don't like the first draft?**
Full refund. No questions.

**What if I want changes?**
Two rounds of revisions are included. Describe what you want in plain words ("move the beach photo to page 3", "add more white space"). No design jargon needed.

**Can I print the book later?**
Yes. You receive a print-ready PDF. Order a printed copy anytime through ReMeet, or take the PDF to any print shop.

**How much does printing cost?**
Hardcover from $69, premium layflat from $129. US and Canada shipping included, Europe +$15. Extra copies $69 each.

**What is the design quality?**
Every book is designed by a person with 10 years in editorial design. No templates. Pages are laid out individually with attention to spacing, photo pairing, and visual rhythm.

**Can I send photos from my phone?**
Yes. Share an iCloud link, Google Photos album, Dropbox folder, or any cloud link. No need to download and re-upload individual photos.

**Do you ship internationally?**
Printed books ship to the US, Canada and Europe. The designed PDF works worldwide.

**Can I get multiple copies?**
Yes. Extra printed copies are $69 each. Useful for grandparents, family members, or team gifts.

**Is there a minimum number of photos?**
No minimum. For a 30-page book, 50-100 photos is a good starting point. For 100 pages, 200-500 photos works well.

**Can I include handwritten notes?**
Yes. Scan or photograph your handwritten notes, letters, or captions. The designer places them next to the matching photos.

**What about organizations and teams?**
ReMeet makes season books for nonprofits, sports teams, schools, and clubs. Share the season's photos, and the designer organizes them into a book your members can order copies of.
